Employment Opportunities

As our clientele expands, so does our spa and salon.  Therefore, we’re welcoming qualified, courteous, and friendly spa and salon professionals who share our vision and commitment of offering Sophisticated Pampering TM to submit an application.

We offer competitive packages that include:
An hourly wage
Flexible schedules
Paid time off
Benefits for full-time team members
Full time and part time positions
Ideal candidates will possess:
Good communication skills and can work well with others
Who are punctual and reliable
A current PA license
Exude confidence
An established book of clients is welcome, but not necessary
CURRENT POSITIONS AVAILABLE:
Hair Stylist
Nail Technician

We are a contemporary, upscale salon that provides a place for indulgence and sophistication. If you are ambitious, a self-starter, and outgoing, call us, we are the salon for you!

Call Tina today (412-281-2566) to see how we can work together to create an experience where indulgence truly does meet sophistication for each and every client.
